headline: Thursday Night Football: C.J. Stroud tosses 3 TDs as Texans overwhelm Colts 26-3
teaser: Stroud goes 21/27 for 194 yards and 3 touchdowns while David Montgomery runs for 107 yards and Will Anderson Jr. records a safety in a 26-3 rout.
story:
The Houston Texans snapped their early-season slide on Thursday night, 19 November, rolling past the Indianapolis Colts 26-3 at NRG Stadium to improve to 4-7.

C.J. Stroud was sharp from start to finish, completing 21 of 27 passes for 194 yards and three touchdowns to Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24 yards), and Marlin Klein (13 yards). Running back David Montgomery pounded Indianapolis on the ground with 26 carries for 107 rushing yards.

On defense, Will Anderson Jr. sacked Colts quarterback Daniel Jones in the end zone for a safety, while Houston limited Indianapolis (3-8) to 182 total yards and 1-of-11 on third down.
whyCareReason: Houston notches a statement 26-3 divisional victory on Thursday Night Football behind three Stroud touchdowns and a safety.
stakes: Houston improves to 4-7 to stay alive in the AFC chase while dropping Indianapolis to 3-8; Jacksonville leads the AFC South at 7-3.
rivalryAngle: Houston limited Daniel Jones to 12-of-27 passing for 144 yards and zero touchdowns.
funFacts: Houston held the ball for 37:46 and outgained Indianapolis 361 to 182 in total yards.
C.J. Stroud completed 77.8 percent of his throws (21/27, 118.2 rating) with 3 TD passes.
Will Anderson Jr. registered a defensive safety by bringing down Daniel Jones in the end zone.
